set_ems_control_enabled.name: Set EMS control state
set_ems_control_enabled.description: Enable or disable EMS control for this Wallbox.

set_relay_matrix.name: Set relay matrix
set_relay_matrix.description: Choose the relay matrix for EMS control.

set_charging_current.name: Set charging current setpoint
set_charging_current.description: Set the charging current requested from the EMS.

value.name: Current setpoint
value.description: EMS charging current in amps: 0 or 6 to 32 A in 1 A steps. 0 A pauses charging and grants no charging current.

set_timeout_period.name: Set EMS timeout period
set_timeout_period.description: Set how long the EMS override remains active.

set_timeout_fallback_relay_matrix.name: Set EMS timeout fallback relay matrix
set_timeout_fallback_relay_matrix.description: Choose the relay matrix used when the EMS timeout expires.

value.name: Fallback relay matrix
value.description: Relay phases to use after timeout.

set_timeout_fallback_current.name: Set EMS timeout fallback current
set_timeout_fallback_current.description: Set the fallback charging current used when the EMS timeout expires.

value.name: Fallback current
value.description: Fallback current in amps: 0 or 6 to 32 A in 1 A steps. 0 A pauses charging and grants no charging current.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Wallbox in your local network.
data_description.port: Modbus TCP port of the Wallbox. The default is 502.
data_description.unit_id: Modbus unit ID of the Wallbox. The Wallbox currently ignores it; keep the recommended value 0.
data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant reads the Wallbox, in seconds: 5 to 300 s. The default is 15 s.
data_description.allow_control: Lets Home Assistant change the charging current and phases of the Wallbox through entities and actions. If an EMS timeout is set on the Wallbox, Home Assistant repeats the setpoints regularly so the Wallbox does not drop back to its fallback values. Off by default so Home Assistant does not interfere with another energy manager such as evcc. You can change this later in the integration options.

invalid_phase_rotation.title: Invalid phase rotation on the Wallbox
invalid_phase_rotation.description: The Wallbox {title} reports the line mapping {line_mapping}, which is an invalid phase rotation (counter-clockwise rotating field). Have the supply connection and the line mapping set during installation checked by a qualified electrician. The phase rotation is checked again only when the integration is reloaded or Home Assistant restarts.
